Interface RoverState

All Known Implementing Classes:
CameraState, DrillState, MovingBackwardState, MovingForwardState, NotMovingState, OffState, SurveyingIdleState
public interface RoverState
State contract for the moon rover; unhandled events are ignored by default.

1.0
